method: verify_corpus.py compares PER-FILE sizes against the sender's manifest. A matching total is not verification - a truncated file compensated by a longer one elsewhere passes it, which is the shape rsync failure takes on a flaky link. An rsync in-flight temp file is reported as an incomplete transfer and blocks the verdict rather than being counted as an unexpected extra.
explicitly_not_shown: Content equality at equal size. A size manifest cannot see content. The cross-machine gate on the training-free baselines is the measurement that addresses this, and it tests the environment at the same time.
